title: Glitter Bow iPhone Charger Case
description_text: Description: Give your charger a glamorous upgrade with our Glitter Bow iPhone Charger Case. Designed with sparkling glitter, elegant pearls, and mini black bow accents, this case turns your regular adapter into a stylish accessory. The durable protective shell keeps your charger safe from scratches, dust, and wear, while the coiled black cable adds extra durability and a sleek touch. Perfect for those who love mixing fashion with function—charging has never looked this pretty!
